item.description: - A window you resized by hand on your other display no longer snaps back to its old width when you move windows on the first display. - The wing sound is now off unless you turn it on, and Full Butterfly no longer turns it on. If you had it on, the update turns it off once. Turn it back on in the menu bar (Wing sound) or in Settings › General, right under Theme.

- Smoother Basic motion: window edges no longer shake when you jump several windows with the mouse wheel or a shortcut. Trackpad swipes work exactly as before. - The card that stands in for a window at the edge of your other display now fades out instead of flickering, and is a little lighter.

- New: pick your Butterfly. Choose Basic or Full Butterfly in the tour, in Settings › General › Theme, or right in the menu bar menu. Full Butterfly turns on the butterfly-wing motion, the new Butterfly tabs and map, and a soft wing sound. You can still turn each part on or off on its own. - New Butterfly tabs: a window with tabs shows them in the shape of the Butterfly icon, each part filled with an app. Click a part to switch tabs; with more than four tabs, "+N" takes you to the next one. - New Butterfly map: the windows on screen sit in the body of the butterfly, the rest in the wings on both sides. Drag a window between others to move it, or rest it over another window to combine them into tabs. - New wing sound: a soft flutter when the strip lands on another window, with its own volume. It stays silent during calls. Off by default; turn it on in Settings › Gestures & Mouse. - If your Dock hides automatically, the window map no longer ends up under it when the Dock slides in. - The menu bar menu shows Theme instead of Motion. Motion styles stay in Settings › Motion.
